answer: In a Proof of Agent network, nodes withstand Sybil attacks via game-theoretic multi-agent auditing over graph clusters. Verifiers identify topological cut bottlenecks, routing audits from the knoll cluster across a narrow bridge ridge into an isolated lotus enclave. Any colluding validator that attests to counterfeit identities suffers automated stake slashing. Because bridging disjoint partitions requires quadratic or superlinear stake commitments, attacker cost scales exponentially with identity count.
